detail.longDescription: I always thought you needed a specialized # AI for # VibeCoding , something like # OpenAI Codex or a similar tool. But today I spent some time experimenting, and it turns out regular # ChatGPT works surprisingly well for this. Especially since I already have unlimited chat usage included in my plan. I simply created a # Plugin to use the # n8n MCP integration, connected # Git through n8n, and now the AI is happily writing code that actually works. For browser-based testing, I still use # Codex with predefined test cases. It runs the tests and just gives me a report afterward. Pretty fascinating to see how well this workflow works! What I'm currently building is a # Friendica addon. I've written about this in some of my previous posts today.
